descriptionChirho: Proper feminine name referring to Jezebel (אִיזֶבֶל), the Phoenician princess who became queen of Israel as wife of Ahab, notorious for promoting Baal worship and persecuting the prophets of YHWH (1 Kings 16-21, 2 Kings 9). English 'Izevel / Jezebel / to–Izevel / is-Jezebel,' Spanish 'Jezabel / de–Jezabel / y–Jezabel,' Hindi 'ईजेबेल / ईजेवेल / वईजेवेल,' Arabic 'إيزَبَل / لِ–إيزَبَل / إيزابَلَ / وَإيزابَلُ,' Korean '이세벨 / 이세벨을 / 이세벨의,' Swahili 'Yezebeli / kwa–Yezebeli / na–Yezebeli.' The two clusters differ only in grammatical context (standalone/prepositional vs. conjunctive); the referent is the same person.
